basic_info.description:
Charming Mission Dolores Duplex with Vacant Top Floor Unit.
Upper unit is vacant and easy to show.
 Lower unit tenants are not protected and paying close to market rents. There have been no evictions or OMI in the building making this perfect for partners who are interested in fast-track condo conversion(Buyer to verify conversion details to their satisfaction). Both units are very large. Upper is six rooms with a split bath. Lower unit is 5 rooms with a split bath and hosting a claw foot bathtub. Both units have beautiful wood floors. This building boasts lots of period details and charm. There is a nice sunny backyard. As a bonus there is an unwarranted garden apartment behind the garage that is now vacant.
